capabilities_done: Dynamics (dynamics.rs): compressor / downward expander / gate; Giannoulis-Massberg-Reiss soft-knee static curve (static_reduction_db is the analytic curve); peak or RMS detector; attack/release one-pole in dB; gate hold; range floor; makeup; stereo link or per-channel; latency 0; block-partition bit-identical

LookaheadLimiter (dynamics.rs): sliding-min + boxcar + release, ceiling -60..0 dB, lookahead 0.1..20 ms, true_peak option via shared 4x polyphase filter (truepeak.rs); latency = lookahead-1 (+6 true peak) reported; sample clamp with clamp_events

LoudnessMeter (loudness.rs): BS.1770-4 K-weighting derived per rate (48k equals table values to 1e-10), 400 ms/100 ms gating blocks with exact integer edges at any admitted rate, momentary, short-term, integrated (-70 abs / -10 LU rel), LRA (-70 / -20 LU, p10-p95), per-channel true peak (4x) and sample peak, caller channel weights (5.1 helper), pass-through Processor + lock-free LoudnessReadout for use inside a Chain
Reverb (reverb.rs): Schroeder-Moorer 8 combs + 4 allpasses per channel, Freeverb tunings scaled by rate, comb gains from rt60, damping, pre-delay <= 200 ms, width, wet/dry, mono/stereo, tail_frames()

NoiseProfiler / NoiseProfile / NoiseReducer (denoise.rs): STFT sqrt-Hann hop N/4 (256..8192), unit gain reconstructs exactly at latency N-1, Wiener-style subtraction gain with over-subtraction and floor, median frequency smoothing, rise/fall time smoothing, profile digest in identity
All processors: validated ranges (NaN -> NotFinite, out of range -> OutOfRange, non-divisor rate -> InvalidRate), identity strings, required_sample_rate_hz, reset

ebu_vectors.substitute_evidence: 48 kHz K-weighting coefficients equal BS.1770-4 table values; 997 Hz 0 dBFS mono = -3.01 LKFS at 44.1/48/96 kHz; constructed-level gating and LRA with analytic expectations; true peak Hann-shaped fs/4 tone within +/-0.1 dB

limitations: LoudnessMeter gate thresholds and LRA percentiles are quantised to 0.01 LU by the histograms (power sums exact); a discarded block resets the whole measurement

True-peak filter is an own 49-tap Kaiser sinc design (not the BS.1770 example coefficients); measured: unshaped hard-onset tone shows +0.10 dB Gibbs overshoot; 0.45 fs tone reads -0.108 dBTP vs true 0 (sample peak equal); accuracy near fs/2 not claimed
LookaheadLimiter true_peak mode: ceiling bound for the oversampled signal verified only on the fs/4 45-degree tone (within 0.25 dB); not proven for arbitrary signals
NoiseReducer: no stereo-linked gain, no residual/musical-noise listening test (measured proxy: passing-cell fraction 0.0705 -> 0.0 with smoothing); profile must match channels, rate and FFT size
Reverb has no modulation or early-reflection model; RT60 accuracy measured T30 within 10 percent on four rate/RT60 pairs
